cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put on a blue badge like yours. Let's enter the quiz together before they close the teams.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine says STAFF. I'm here to collect the entry fees.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, getting us entered. Put my name beside yours and we'll sort out the fee as a team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's twenty pounds each, and the losing team stays to clear the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then write our names down before you collect. We can decide who covers what once we're a team.
